settings.title: Settings
settings.clearAllConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all notes? This action cannot be undone.

availability.iosOnly: iOS only — not available on Android
availability.androidOnly: Android only — not available on iOS
availability.appleIntelligenceDownloading: Apple Intelligence is downloading — try again shortly

settings.updatedUI: Soft-UI shadows give a tactile, elevated feel. Toggle off for the classic flat look.
settings.darkMode: Switch between light and dark appearance. For system settings, use the option below.
settings.useSystemTheme: Automatically match your device's light or dark mode setting.
settings.language: Choose your preferred language for the app interface. System default follows your device.
settings.biometricLock: Require Face ID or Touch ID to unlock the app and protect your notes.
settings.lockTimeout: How long after closing the app before the biometric lock activates.
settings.syncFrequently: Pulls from tracked repositories when the app comes to the foreground, when network reconnects, and on the chosen interval. Recommended for multi-device use.
settings.syncInterval: How often the app automatically pulls for new changes when sync frequently is enabled.
settings.backgroundSync: Background sync runs even when the app is not active, ensuring your notes stay up to date.
settings.cloneMode: Clone mode syncs through a local git working tree. Requires more storage but works fully offline with LFS support.
settings.apiMode: API mode uses the GitHub Contents API for per-file operations. Faster initially but requires network and lacks offline support.
settings.lfsFiles: Large files tracked by Git LFS are downloaded on demand. Download pending files to view them offline.
settings.templatesRepo: Connect a GitHub repository to store and sync your custom note templates.
settings.clearData: Permanently deletes all notes, todos, and canvases from this device. Your files in GitHub are not affected.
settings.resetOnboarding: Show the welcome screens again on next app launch. Does not delete any data.
settings.enableAI: Enable the AI chat assistant to help you organize notes, generate content, and more.
settings.actionModeAuto: AI performs actions automatically without asking for confirmation.
settings.actionModeConfirm: AI asks for confirmation before performing write operations like creating or deleting notes.
settings.chatStorage: Choose which repository to store AI chat conversations in.
settings.providers: AI providers allow you to connect different AI services. Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing for privacy.
settings.scheduledLearning: Schedule daily reviews of notes with specific tags. The app sends reminders to help you learn and remember your notes.
